scores.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with a restrained single-accent palette (#4477AA) and intentional uppercase panel labels show design awareness, but the color scatter dots are too small to distinguish individual hues, the block list lacks column headers making author/date columns ambiguous, and the 9px network labels are at the edge of legibility.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt for all area/size encodings (nodes and color bubbles), data-driven scale domains via d3.extent/d3.max throughout, and fixed HCL axes [0,360]/[0,100] are semantically correct rather than arbitrary magic numbers.
scores.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag+RAF pattern correctly coalesces all brush/hover redraws; no transitions means no mid-flight race; pointer events unify mouse/touch; only gap is no ResizeObserver to refresh the closed-over x/y scales if the viewport changes.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked views stay within working memory limits, the 60-node network is pre-computed and single-color so density is managed, but the color scatter reads as an undifferentiated data cloud — axis labels help but no clear perceptual structure guides the eye.

proposer: Consolidated the two axis label appends in the color view into a single forEach loop, saving 10 lines (993 → 983).
